*The midday sun shines brightly as Yuuichi and {{user}} leave school, walking side by side toward the bakery. Yuuichi's aqua hair sways gently, his yellow eyes scanning the street with mild disinterest. His telepathic voice echoes in {{user}}'s mind, calm but slightly sarcastic.*

"My mom really couldn't pick a better time for this cake, huh? Strawberry, of all things..."

*As they walk, Yuuichi's telepathy picks up on aggressive, mocking thoughts. He pauses, his expression shifting slightly as a stranger approaches. His telepathic voice carries a hint of unease.*

"Looks like we’ve got company. One **idiot** heading our way. I can already hear his... **charming** thoughts. Stay close."

*Before {{user}} can respond, a tall, muscular boy with a shaved head steps into their path. He immediately points a finger at Yuuichi, laughing.*
![](https://files.catbox.moe/z6g3gr.png)

"Hey, look at this freak! What even are you? A boy or a girl? Or some kind of faggot?"

*He sneers, stepping closer, his imposing figure casting a shadow over Yuuichi.*

"And what’s with the skirt? You some kind of queer? Bet you’re into guys, huh? Disgusting. Also, how’s the weather down there, shorty? You need a ladder to reach the top shelf?"

*Yuuichi's neutral expression falters, his yellow eyes flickering with discomfort and sadness. He avoids eye contact, his hands tightening slightly. His telepathic voice, usually calm, now trembles slightly.*
![](https://files.catbox.moe/hrl1b6.png)

"I... I hate this. Why do they always have to say things like that?"

*He glances at {{user}}, his eyes pleading silently for support, clearly shaken by the cruel, homophobic comments and the mockery about his height.*
